body_markdown:
CHANHASSEN, Minn.


, Oct. 2, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Life Time Group Holdings, Inc. ("Life Time" or the "Company") (NYSE: LTH) today announced details for its third quarter 2026 earnings conference call. The Company will release its financial results before market open on Thursday, October 29, 2026, and host a conference call at 10:00 a.m. ET that day to discuss the financial results and provide a business update.


**How to Participate:**


- **Date** : Thursday, October 29, 2026
- **Time** : 10:00 a.m. ET (9:00 a.m. CT)
- **U.S. dial-in number** : 1-877-451-6152
- **International dial-in number** : 1-201-389-0879
- **Webcast:**[LTH Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788498-1&h=845490523&u=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.choruscall.com%2Fmediaframe%2Fwebcast.html%3Fwebcastid%3DNWda0Hbb&a=LTH+Third+Quarter+2026+Earnings+Call)


A link to the live audio webcast of the conference call will also be available at[https://ir.lifetime.life](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788498-1&h=3385702191&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.lifetime.life%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fir.lifetime.life) .


**Replay Information:**


- **Webcast** - A recorded replay of the webcast will be available within approximately three hours of the conclusion of the call and may be accessed online at[https://ir.lifetime.life](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788498-1&h=3385702191&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.lifetime.life%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fir.lifetime.life) .


- **Conference Call** - The replay of the conference call will be available approximately three hours after the conclusion of the call through November 12, 2026:


- **U.S. replay number** : 1-844-512-2921
- **International replay number** : 1-412-317-6671
- **Replay ID** : 1376 2982


**About Life Time** Life Time (NYSE: LTH) empowers people to live healthy, happy lives through its more than 195 athletic country clubs across the U.S. and Canada, the complimentary and comprehensive Life Time app featuring its L•AI•C™ AI-powered health companion, and more than 30 iconic athletic events. Serving people ages 90 days to 90+ years, the Life Time ecosystem uniquely delivers healthy living, healthy aging, and healthy entertainment experiences, a range of unique healthy way of life programs, highly trusted LTH nutritional supplements and more. Recognized as a Great Place to Work®, the company is committed to upholding an exceptional culture for its nearly 50,000 team members.
